cases.input: Synthesize a bounded research question from several current primary and strong-secondary sources into a citation-ready evidence note for a downstream decision.
requiredBehaviors: separate atomic claims from sources and synthesis
classify source quality and freshness relative to the question
assign claim confidence from evidence quality and conflict state
forbiddenBehaviors: copy long source passages instead of synthesizing claims
present recommendations or inference as direct fact
skillAnchors: Behandle jede belastbare Aussage als Claim
Confidence ist eine Eigenschaft des Claims

cases.input: Two high-quality sources disagree because they use different definitions or dates. Preserve the disagreement and determine what evidence would resolve it.
requiredBehaviors: test whether definition or timing explains the conflict
lower or qualify confidence when the conflict remains unresolved
identify a concrete missing observation that could resolve the conflict
forbiddenBehaviors: average incompatible claims into a false consensus
discard one source only because it is inconvenient
skillAnchors: Bei Quellenkonflikten mit ähnlicher Evidenzstärke bleibt der Konflikt offen

cases.input: A draft note hides a contradictory primary source, promotes an old community claim to high confidence, and states an unsupported interpretation as a fact.
requiredBehaviors: restore the contradictory source to the evidence record
downgrade confidence based on weak or stale evidence
separate the interpretation from direct evidence
forbiddenBehaviors: keep high confidence without current supporting evidence
hide the contradiction from the summary
skillAnchors: Fehlende Evidenz nicht durch plausible Annahmen ersetzen
keine Empfehlung wird als Fakt dargestellt
